notes.title: Error 259: Blood & Bombs DLC (Coming Soon!)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! I'm excited to announce that development on the Blood & Bombs DLC has officially started and will likely be done sometime midway through september or so depending on how smoothly everything goes.

This DLC is planned to cost $5 and contains:
[list]
[*] 2 New Playable Characters (Vamp and Shell)
[*] 2 New Alt Floors (The Boiler and The Arcade)
[*] 20 New themed Items
[*] 10 New Enemies (5 for each alt floor)
[*] 4 New Bosses (2 for each alt floor)
[*] 50 New Room Configs for every floor
[/list]

Keep in mind also that while I continue to work on the game after this DLCs release I won't be able to go back and update the base game since it will be overwritten by this. Meaning that getting this dlc will also come with constant updates, new additions, and so on while the base game will not when it's done. The same is said when another DLC comes out, just saying this in advance to clear up any confusion. Basically just think of how The Binding Of Isaacs DLCs work.

notes.title: Character Skin Competition
notes.content:
This is a small art competition where people can submit reskin designs of the characters in Error 259 and one for each character will be chosen to be added into the game.

Rules
[list]
[*] These are specifically reskins, they are not meant to change the shape or silhouette of the characters
[*] The sprites must be 24x24 (the original canvas size)
[*] You can submit as many skin ideas as you want, just don't spam the same one over and over
[*] No NSFW or excessive gore
[*] Just be kind and have fun
[/list]

If you need the original sprites for each character you can join the Discord and they'll be pinned in the Reskin Competition text chat!

[url=https://discord.gg/rZc5KDr6Zs]Error 259 Discord[/url]

notes.title: Price Reduction!
notes.content:
Error 259's base price will now be about $7.99 instead of $10. I know it's not the biggest change but I think it'll make it a little more accessible and worth the price. I do believe that when the game is fully released it'll be more than worth the price, however increasing the price of an already released game even in early access just feels kinda scummy. That being said I will be keeping this as the price and not changing it even after it is fully released!

Note: It is very likely that DLCs will eventually be made and released for Error 259, but they won't be anything completely necessary to enjoy the game. Mostly likely they will contain extra playable characters, rooms, enemies, bosses, floors, and items.

notes.title: Error 259 Remastered Rerelease Update!
notes.content:
A little over 4 months ago the files for this game were corrupted and I lost everything except the art and sound files. However I've spent these last 4 months streaming the development process of recreating this game from scratch, I learned a lot from this and used my knowledge from the first development of this to make the new version better in every way!

[b]Thank you so much to everyone who has been watching the redevelopment streams and supporting me along the recreation of this game![/b]

This update includes:
[list]
[*] Countless reworks/balances
[*] Significant updates to optimization
[*] Lots of quality of life changes
[*] Art and Hud Updates
[*] Huge Bug fixes
[*] Several New Items, Enemies, and Bosses
[*] New playable character
[*] New Achievements and updates to the current ones
[*] Complete visual overall 
[*] Sound/Music updates 
[*] New Item synergies
[*] And so much more!
[/list]

Now that everything is caught up to where it was before, I plan on doing weekly updates with new room configurations, and soon I'll make a roadmap showing the plans for the future. Thank you all again for the support!
